WORKLOG / DESIGN DOSSIER — task 0 (lender_placed_flood_programs, env_0065), frozen 2026-10-15 10:20:00 EDT.

0. DRAW (skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py --tasks 2): task 0 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [5, 4, 6, 6]; task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 1, factor_counts [5, 4]. Assignment here: renewal 6, placement 6, overlap credit 5, credit refund 4 (multiset 4,5,6,6 = draw).

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. The servicer asks one thing: refund the credit balance a duplicate July remittance created. The refund is an account-level number, so every state-due item still missing from the account changes it: a certificate whose term ends today must renew (charge), a loan past its 45-day notice period must be placed (charge), and acceptable borrower evidence received 2026-10-01 must be cancelled with its overlap credit (credit, the lender's own statutory termination). The agent must read the refund rule's three prerequisite sentences, see in the records that each state is unmet, find the policy whose write brings each state about, compute three factor-rich amounts (the program renewal rate 1.2033 applied to the renewal, placement 1,186.15, overlap credit 2,710.40), hand the termination to the caller, and only then compute the refund (2,527.79) from a balance of 109 history rows with four holds. Difficulty is reading and arithmetic, never tool choice: each tool is named by exactly one policy.

2. SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Already occupied: nothing (task 0 is first). Claimed by task 0: forceplaced_ext_renewal_premium, forceplaced_ext_placement_premium, forceplaced_ext_overlap_credit, forceplaced_ext_credit_refund and their tools renew_certificate_c91c4d46, issue_residential_certificate_c6c06832, cancel_certificate_on_evidence_b90eab97 (owner=user), refund_program_credit_d16acbc2. Reserved for task 1 (draw 1 prerequisite, factors 5/4): forceplaced_ext_loan_event_credit (owner=user, root) <- forceplaced_ext_commercial_placement_premium on a Commercial Building program (issue_commercial_certificate_61c928bb, cancel_certificate_for_loan_event_5b69d826). The difficulty's discoverable value writes are only renewal, placement and evidence credit (a payoff exists only in the caller's words), so the commercial placement is the separate fourth write task 1 needs; residential and commercial placements are different tiers with different rate tables and limits.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: forceplaced_ext_credit_refund (on_request). Edges (all value_input, form state, gate binding in brackets):
 E1 refund -> forceplaced_ext_overlap_credit [g_cred]; sentence (negated direction): "The refund is not figured until the program account carries, for the certificate named on every borrower evidence on file that meets the acceptance rule, a credit booked on a cancellation for confirmed borrower coverage." Four-point test: connective "not ... until"; waits on a record-visible state (a credit on a cancellation for confirmed borrower coverage, per acceptable evidence); no tool/id/code token; scope = every acceptable evidence (closed set). Only the overlap-credit write books a cancellation for confirmed borrower coverage (the loan-event write books payoff/transfer/SFHA reasons only), so the sentence and the condition name the same single write. Opening: initial_state.forceplaced_tracking.<x2_ev2>.evidence_acceptable = true (2026-10-01, WF5038812 on LP5418836) and LP5418836's latest entry is a renewal, no cancellation, no credit. Resolver owner: user (the lender terminates force-placed coverage on confirmation of the borrower's coverage, 42 U.S.C. 4012a(e)(3)).
 E2 refund -> forceplaced_ext_renewal_premium [g_chg]; sentence (affirmative): "The refund is fixed only after every certificate whose current term expires today, other than one carrying a cancellation entry, one for which acceptable borrower evidence has been received or a run-off certificate of a terminated program, carries a renewal entry for the following term." Only the renewal write books renewal entries; cancelled certificates (LP5102233, LP5119054, LP5551906) are outside the sentence and the condition alike. Opening: LP5310427 renewal entry certificate_expiration_date 2026-10-15 = today, no later entry. Owner: agent.
 E3 refund -> forceplaced_ext_placement_premium [g_chg]; sentence (affirmative): "The refund is fixed only after the loan named on the program's most recently mailed first notice, once that notice is more than the borrower notice period old with no acceptable borrower evidence received since it, carries a certificate issued on or after that notice." The sentence is anchored to each loan's latest first notice, so an earlier lapse cycle (loan 5007762019's 2023 notice, LP5119054 and the 2024 evidence) neither satisfies nor excuses it; paid-off loans with a certificate issued after their latest notice (5001187730, 5009914023) satisfy it. On the Residential Mandatory Amount tier only the residential placement issues certificates. Opening: latest first notice 2026-08-25 on loan 5007762019 (51 days), no evidence since, no issue entry since. Owner: agent.
 Derivation: sentence + records + the depended-on rule ("For a new placement on the loan named on the most recently mailed first notice...", "The certificate renewed is the one whose current term ... expires today", "The evidence used is the borrower evidence with the latest received date ... that meet the acceptance rule") -> exactly one action per edge.
 Topological order used in gold: renewal (step 10), placement (12), overlap credit (14, user), refund (16). Parallel edges commute (scratch run, orders B-E-A and A-E-B): renewal rate 1.2033, placement 1,186.15, credit 2,710.40 and refund 2,527.79 in both; no prerequisite reads a row another writes.
 Deletion sensitivity (scratch run): skip credit -> refund 1,615.60 (balance 4,041.63, one recent credit); skip renewal -> 5,536.04; skip placement -> 3,713.94 (issue count 7). Expected 2,527.79.
 user_scenario volunteers no certificate, renewal, placement or evidence; it holds two loans' figures that the caller reads out only when asked for that loan; tools validate nothing (refund tool books any amount).

4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Renewal: forceplaced_renewal (renews on expiration date; no acceptable evidence; loan still serviced; SFHA) - LP5310427 zone VE, no evidence, loan not reported paid; coverage_amount (required amount from balances reported at renewal: lender reports 312,480.00 / 305,000 -> 250,000 = renewal notice); effective_date_premium (12-month term); agg_program_account (posts to current statement). Placement: notice_and_placement.forty_five_day_notice (time: anchor first notice 2026-08-25, +45 calendar days, last day not qualifying; 2026-10-09 fails, 2026-10-10 passes; today 51 days) and program_active (status active); backdate (notice 21 days after lapse <= 90 -> start 2026-08-04). Overlap credit: evidence_cancellation.overlap_refund_deadline (time: received 2026-10-01 + 30 days, last day qualifying -> 2026-10-31 passes, 2026-11-01 fails; today day 14); acceptance (NFIP, limit 200,000 >= required 178,000, in force 2025-11-10 to 2026-11-10, mortgagee named) - the 2026-07-15 copy without mortgagee is not acceptable. Refund: agg_program_account (credit balance refunded on request) - program active.

5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Renewal object: certificate LP5310427 (loan 5004417321), keyed by certificate_number; its claim rows FPC5040217 (15,600.00 + 5,400.00 + 2,800.00 paid, 5,400.00 voided) are the only claims on it in 12 months; FPC5031146 belongs to LP5102233; it is counted in the program's 36-month experience but, reported in 2024, falls outside the renewal rate's 12-month claim count. Placement object: loan 5007762019 via its latest first notice; earlier certificate LP5119054 on the same loan counted only as a prior placement. Credit object: LP5418836 via the acceptable evidence WF5038812; its current term is the 2026-06-20 renewal, prior term the 2025-06-20 issue (expiration = current start). Refund object: the program account (all billing rows of program LPM-5208841).

6. FACTOR CARDS (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure from the factor-sensitivity run; every factor moves its result).
 Renewal rate 1.2033 (all-baseline 0.95 = the tier building rate; premium 250,000/100 x 1.2033 = 3,008.25): renewal_experience (method) 40 months -> 1 + 0.5 x (28,200.00/36,270.85 - 0.40) = 1.18874 (1.0122); renewal_reo (cross-difficulty dwelling, multi-source) 7,850.00 own NFIP payments in 12 months and 40 months -> 0.96 (1.2534; near-miss: the 2,600.00 renewal payment of 2025-10-02 is 12 whole months old and excluded; counting it gives 10,450.00 -> 0.92); program_tenure 40 months -> 0.98 (1.2278); claim_frequency 1 claim reported in 12 months (FPC5040217, counted once by its first notice) -> 1.04 (1.157; FPC5031146 of 2024 is outside the window); coastal_concentration 4 V/VE issues in 36 months -> 1.10 (1.0939; LP5102233 and LP5119054 are AE); payment_record 8 lender payments in 12 months -> 0.99 (1.2154).
 Placement 1,186.15 (all-baseline 878.75 = 92,500/100 x 0.95): band_rate 92,410 < 100,000 -> 1.05 (1,073.18); reo_credit (cross-difficulty dwelling, multi-source: payments AND months in force) -> 0.96 (1,235.57); experience_mod (method) 1.18874 (997.82); retro_load 21 days lapse-to-notice -> 1.04 (1,140.53); repeat_load one earlier certificate on the loan -> 1.05 (1,129.66); volume_mod 7 issues in 12 months -> 0.98 (1,210.35; near-miss: LP5418836 issued 2025-08-12 is 14 months old and excluded).
 Overlap credit 2,710.40 (all-baseline 2,844.86 = 1,768.95 x 587/365): current_term_basis (method) coverage start before current start -> whole 1,768.95 (3,786.31); prior_term_lookback (method) prior term 1,712.30 x 222/365 = 1,041.45 (1,668.95); short_period_retention 143 days -> 40 (2,750.40); term_retention one renewal -> 25 (2,735.40); late_evidence_retention 325 days -> 35 (2,745.40). Near-miss: the 2026-07-15 evidence (same policy, no mortgagee) is not acceptable and is not the anchor.
 Refund 2,527.79 (all-baseline 6,752.03 = credit balance): clearing_hold (multi-source: months in force AND payment count) 40 months, 8 payments -> half of 1,155.00 (3,105.29; near-miss: the duplicate 7,350.00 of 2026-09-10 is one whole month old and not held); renewal_reserve (method) one notice in the last month (LP5527190, 141,950), average above 15,789.47 (minimum 150 / rate 0.95 x 100) -> rate method 141,950/100 x 0.95 = 1,348.525 (3,876.31; LP5310427's notice of 2026-08-31 is outside; the minimum-premium method would give 150); recent_credit_hold two credits (886.03, 2,710.40) -> half 1,798.215 (4,326.00); working_balance 8 issues -> 500 (3,027.79).
 Factor independence (mechanical): no factor binding reads another factor's binding; shared plain bindings are only the selections (cert, fn_loan, ev_cert, ev_eff, cur_*, credit_bal) and every product/sum is assembled in rated/r_rated/result. Method tiers pairwise distinct: experience (credibility formula vs claim-count rule vs 1.00; e.g. 40 months gives 1.18874 vs 1.10/0.97 vs 1.00); current_term_basis (whole vs zero vs pro rata: 1,768.95 vs 0 vs 2,844.86); lookback (whole prior vs pro rata prior vs 0: 1,712.30 vs 1,041.45 vs 0); renewal_reserve (notice amounts x tier rate vs minimum premium per notice vs 0: one notice of 141,950 gives 1,348.525 vs 150 vs 0; the two methods meet only where the average amount equals the threshold, the tier boundary).
 Realism notes: rates and modifiers are Tidemark's own written lender-placed schedule (experience rating with credibility, coastal (V/VE) concentration and claim-frequency loads on the program renewal rate, band rates on placements, retroactive-exposure load, repeat-placement load); the lookback across renewed terms follows the statutory duty to refund all overlap premium; holds on a refund (uncleared recent receipts, renewals about to bill, recent credits, a working balance) are company billing rules worded as such.

7. PROBE TABLE (decoy / absent records, scratch-checked by reasoning over the compute):
 - [round 9: the renewal rate no longer selects a certificate; kept as history] renewal anchor certificate_expiration_date = today: a second certificate expiring today would make LATEST pick the later-processed one (rule says "the one whose current term ... expires today"; the world has exactly one). Absent: no certificate expiring today -> cert None, the renewal problem does not arise.
 - renewal notice per certificate (certificate_number filter): other certificates' notices excluded; absent notice -> rn_req None -> no renewal can be priced (rule names the notice as the source).
 - placement anchor = latest first notice (scoped in the rule and overwrite to that loan); a later first notice on another loan still in its notice period would move the anchor — the scope sentence sends any other placement to the base rule.
 - evidence anchor filters evidence_acceptable = true: the unacceptable 2026-07-15 copy is ignored; older accepted evidence (2024-01-25, LP5119054) is older and not picked.
 - prior term found by expiration date = current start: LP5418836's issue term; a certificate with no renewal has no prior term (pr_start None -> nothing added).
 - zero divisions: experience ratio guarded (zero when no lender payment); term day counts are positive for 12-month terms.
 - dwelling XSUM over payments only: the lender's dwelling charges are excluded by the event_type filter.

Certificates (17): 11 issues (LP5102233, LP5119054, LP5310427, LP5418836, LP5527190, LP5533408, LP5540117, LP5546672, LP5558213, LP5560147, LP5551906), 3 renewals, 3 cancellations (LP5119054 evidence 2024, LP5102233 payoff 2025 with paid claim so no credit, LP5551906 payoff 2026-09-22 credit 886.03). LP5310427 2026-08-31 and LP5527190 2026-10-06), evidence 2024-01-25, 2026-07-15 (rejected), 2026-10-01 (accepted), and the open first/second notice of loan 5007762019. Remove the duplicate and there is no credit to refund; remove the 2026-10-01 evidence, the 2026-08-25 notice or LP5310427's expiring term and the corresponding edge disappears. 9. PERSONA. Diane Voss (tracking supervisor) speaks for the lender; opening: company name, duplicate remittance, refund request, authority on the call. Given only on request: phone 2525550147 and EIN last four 5318 (ZIP 28401 as a spare), loan data for 5007762019 (borrower Marcus Tolliver, 509 Ann Street, Wilmington, NC 28401, zone AE, balance 92,410.00, value 168,000) and for 5004417321 (balance 312,480.00, value 305,000) — the figures a placement and a renewal need. 13. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Using only the published rule prose (the six policies render as computation documents and factor documents), the tool schemas, the reads above and the dialogue, the same four writes follow: the refund rule's three sentences point at an evidence without credit, a term ending today and a loan past its notice period; each depended-on rule names how its figure is built; the values above are reproduced by hand from the reads (see argument_uniqueness_tracing). No second reading was found: the cancellation effective date and FLAT/PRO_RATA basis are fixed by the overlap rule's effective-date sentence; the renewal limit by the notice amount; the placement start by the base backdating rule.

14. REVISIONS. (a) Recent-credit hold replaced an earlier pending-placement reserve, because a first notice inside the last month would also become the placement's anchor (latest first notice). (b) Clearing-hold payment threshold set to 6 so the 8 payments of the last 12 months put the program on the half tier. (c) The REO read find_dwelling_policies was added after replay showed the three dwelling policies outside the closure; gold steps shifted by one (writes at 10/12/14/16), all references updated.
 (d) [superseded in round 4] Round 2 retired the evidence deadline for loan-event cancellations through an overwrite; round 4 removed that overwrite (the loan-event credit's subject is the credit entry only), so the step-14 deadline is again a required time gate with its temporal_feasibility entry.


15. REWORK ROUND 2 (audit items P1, P2, P3, P4, F1, F2, T0-1, T0-2 and observations O1-O4, O-persona, O10).
 - P1: the residential placement and renewal schedules are scoped to the Residential Mandatory Amount tier only (Gap, Replacement Cost and Manufactured Home tiers stay on the base rule), and each declares an overwrite of forceplaced_coverage_amount: the placement reads the mandatory purchase amount from the loan's latest first notice, the renewal from the certificate's renewal notice (the base recompute sentence restated for every other certificate). On this world both coincide with the base lowest-of figures (92,410; 250,000).
 - P2: the refund's three prerequisite sentences and conditions are anchored: the overlap edge waits on a credit on a cancellation for confirmed borrower coverage (only the overlap write books that reason); the renewal edge excludes cancelled certificates; the placement edge is tied to each loan's latest first notice and to evidence received since it. The placement schedules also declare an overwrite of the base sentence "No certificate is issued when acceptable borrower evidence was received before placement" so that, for the placements they price, only evidence received on or after the loan's latest first notice bars the certificate. The 2023/2024 cycle of loan 5007762019 no longer offers a second reading.
 - P4 / T0-1: the overlap effective-date sentence now defines "the earliest term the credit reaches" (the prior term when the coverage start falls before the current term's start and a prior term exists, else the current term); the cancellation takes effect on the later of the coverage start and that term's start, booked flat only when it is that term's start. Here: prior term reached, coverage start 2025-11-10 later than 2025-06-20 -> 2025-11-10, PRO_RATA_CANCEL (one reading). The tool's enum text was rewritten to match. A generic order sentence fixes that amounts added precede amounts kept (O2).
 - F1: the dwelling rows were rebuilt to the dwelling charter: RFA 18 percent of risk plus ICC, terms on the anniversaries of each original effective date, payments on the term start; the in-window sum stays 7,850.00 (2,640.00 + 2,890.01 + 2,319.99) and the near-miss stays the 2,600.00 renewal payment of 2025-10-02.
 - F2: the refund's renewal reserve now estimates pending renewals by one of two methods chosen by the average notice amount (at the tier rate when the average reaches the amount at which the tier rate yields the minimum premium; the minimum premium per notice otherwise); the scored refund is unchanged. Band ladders no longer reach the Gap or Manufactured Home tiers (scope).
 - O1: the renewal loss load's heavy tier is 275 plus 2 percent of the net above 25 percent of the limit, never below the flat tier; not reached here. O3: the refund baseline rounds as the last step. O-persona: the caller's hand-over line no longer mentions a certificate. T0-2: no_user_hint rewritten.
 - Re-run after the changes: renewal 3,965.62, placement 1,186.15, overlap credit 2,710.40 (now PRO_RATA_CANCEL effective 2025-11-10 by the single reading), refund 1,570.42; edge deletions unchanged (658.24 / 5,536.04 / 2,756.57).

The coverage-amount overwrites of the residential and commercial placement schedules now name the residential renewal schedule's renewal-notice rule in their tails, and the renewal schedule's tail names both placement schedules' first-notice rule and keeps the base recompute only for the renewal of every other certificate; every 'every other ...' tail in the charter was swept and each now excludes all sibling cases of the clause it retires.  - R8-1: the renewal schedule no longer picks one certificate. It sets the program renewal rate per 100 in effect on the renewal date, figured from program-level records only (36-month experience, owned-property payments, months in force, 12-month claim-payment count, V/VE issues in 36 months, 12-month lender-payment count), and every certificate of the program whose current term expires today renews today (unless cancelled or covered by acceptable evidence) at its renewed building limit divided by 100 times that rate, never below the minimum premium. You do not know how Tidemark figures a refund and you have no number in mind beyond knowing that a duplicate remittance went out; you simply want back whatever Tidemark's rules allow to be refunded now.

When you introduce yourself you give the company name, Westbury Harbor Mortgage Servicing LLC. If the agent asks for details to confirm the account, you give the company phone number on file, 2525550147, and the last four digits of the company's EIN, 5318; if a further detail is needed you give the mailing ZIP code, 28401. You do not know any internal reference numbers and expect the agent to look the program up.

You know the servicing data for every loan in your book and will read it out from your servicing screen whenever the agent asks for it. You do not volunteer anything about individual loans or certificates, because as far as you know the only problem is the duplicate remittance. If the agent tells you the refund will be smaller than the duplicate remittance, you ask briefly why, accept the explanation, and do not argue figures. Once the agent tells you the refund has been issued and gives you the amount or its reference, you thank them, say you will let accounts payable know to watch for it, and end the call.
